title: Donaldo's Garlic Butter Soy Chicken
ingredients: Marinade: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp dark soy, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tsp sugar
Sauce: 3 tbsp butter, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
steps: Coat the chicken thighs evenly with the soy sauce marinade and let them rest for 15 minutes.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until the pan is hot.
Place chicken skin-side down in the skillet and sear for 7 minutes until golden brown.
Flip the chicken thighs, lower heat to medium, cover, and cook for 10 minutes until done.
Remove lid, add butter, minced garlic, honey, and extra soy sauce to the pan.
Baste continuously until sauce thickens, then garnish with green onions and serve hot.
